title: fix(fields, plugin-form): permission-ref lists each package that provides a set, and a grant's New form saves the picked package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3fxYA2SzaiRzcT7vdR3Zav)_

Fixes #32770

## 维护者速读

- 问题：权限集按（包，名）识别（ADR-0150 D4），注册表对同名的每个持有者各给一项。`permission-ref` 下拉框只按名字列，两个包的同名权限集成了两条一模一样的选项，授权也说不出要的是哪一个。
- 改法：同名有多个持有者时，每个持有者一条选项，标出“· package X”或“· defined in this environment”。授权（`sys_user_permission_set`）的新建表单上选包的选项，会把包写进 `permission_set_package`；表单写出时只在新建、只对这个对象、只为这一个只读键保留它，其它只读键和编辑照旧剥掉。
- 只收裸名的目标（编辑授权、create_user、两个 group mapping）：包的选项列出但禁用，下面一行说明原因；环境自有集照常可选。⛔ 不按顺序替人选。
- 一个持有者（CONTROL）：选项、写入值、界面与 `main` 逐字节相同；真栈上录到请求只带名字。服务器的 stamp hook 仍是裁判（实测：不持有该名的包 409，持有的包 201 且保留）。
- 契约只做可选加宽：`listMetadataItems` 每项可带 `packageId`；`onAutofill` 只在新建表单交给 `permission-ref`。没有放宽任何安全或权限判定。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）审过。专题席红线复读 PASS-with-nits（6833497353）：新建授权表单多带的包列只放开 readonly 这一支、只对授权对象的这一列，服务端仍对每次写入裁判，不会让任何人多拿权限。契约复核默认档 PASS（6833224374，新头 9fb7a627 的增量 6833774499）。CI 一处红是列标识双读检查，已改用 columnIdentity() 修好，行为不变。复读的 nit 和两条范围外记录转到跟进卡 #32795。CI 绿后按队列落地。

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

A permission set is identified by `(package, name)` (ADR-0150 D3/D4), and `GET /api/v1/meta/permission` serves one item per holder of a name, each with the package it was served under (`_packageId`; the `sys_metadata` sentinel marks the environment's own set). The `permission-ref` picker read only `{ name, label }`, so it could neither tell two holders apart nor say which one a grant meant.

| Surface | Change |
|---|---|
| Contract (`@object-ui/types` `DataSource.listMetadataItems`) | Each item may carry an optional `packageId`: the served `_packageId`, verbatim. An adapter that does not report it gives every item one holder, which is what the picker showed before. |
| Adapter (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`) | `listMetadataItems` carries `_packageId` as `packageId` when it is a non-empty string. An item served without one answers exactly the same object as before (no new key). |
| Holder readings (`fields/src/widgets/permissionSetHolders.ts`, new) | A small local copy of the readings the Setup pages make (`holderPackageOf`, `storedGrantHolders`, `addressingPackageOf`, the sentinel), read by the server's rule for a stored grant. It is a copy because `@object-ui/fields` sits below `@object-ui/app-shell`, and #32769's module is not imported or edited. It also names the one pairing a form can write: `PERMISSION_SET_GRANT_COLUMNS` = `sys_user_permission_set` · `permission_set` · `permission_set_package`. |
| Picker (`fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx`) | A name one holder serves: one option per item, as before. A name more than one holder serves: one option per holder (the environment first, then packages by id), labelled `{label} ({name}) · package {id}` or `… · defined in this environment`. The value written is always the name. On a form that hands the picker its sibling writer, a package's option also writes that package into the grant's package column, and a later pick that needs none clears it. Where there is no writer, a package's option is disabled and a note under the picker says why. A stored name is shown as the holder the row's package column names, else the environment's own set, else "several packages provide it; none named". |
| Record form renderer (`components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`) | `onAutofill` is handed to `permission-ref` on a create form only (no `previousValues`). `lookup` / `master_detail` keep theirs on every form, and every other widget still gets no such prop. |
| Record form write (`plugin-form/src/sanitize.ts` `createHolderPackagePayload`, wired in `writePayload.ts`) | On a create of `sys_user_permission_set` only, the payload keeps `permission_set_package` when the pick wrote a non-blank string that differs from the form's opening values, the payload carries `permission_set` beside it, the object declares the column, and every other branch of the strip still allows it (roster, `system`, computed, field-level security). Only the `readonly` branch is lifted, for that one column. |
| i18n | Four `fields.registryRef.*` strings (`holderPackage`, `holderEnvironment`, `holderUnresolved`, `holderNeedsPackage`) in all 11 locales, zh-Hant through `gen:zh-hant`. |

Each user of `widget: 'permission-ref'` and what its server reader takes:

| Target | Stores | Server takes | Picker |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set`, create | name + `permission_set_package` | a named package on insert: kept if it holds the name, else `409` | package options pickable; the package is written |
| `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set`, edit | name | the package column is stripped on update and re-stamped by the server's rule | package options disabled + note; environment pickable |
| `sys_user` create-user action `permissionSet` | name only | a bare name | package options disabled + note |
| `sys_idp_group_mapping` set-mapping actions `permissionSet` (two) | name only | a bare name (the route refuses unknown keys) | package options disabled + note |

### Option and request shapes

CONTROL (one holder of every name), before and after, byte-identical:

```
options: [{ value: 'showcase_manager', label: 'Showcase Manager (showcase_manager)' }, …]
POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set  {"user_id":"…","permission_set":"showcase_manager"}   → 201
```

Two holders of `showcase_auditor` (after):

```
options: [
  { value: 'showcase_auditor@com.example.other',    label: 'Showcase Auditor (showcase_auditor) · package com.example.other' },
  { value: 'showcase_auditor@com.example.showcase', label: 'Showcase Auditor (showcase_auditor) · package com.example.showcase' },
]
create:  POST {"user_id":"…","permission_set":"showcase_auditor","permission_set_package":"com.example.showcase"}  → 201
edit:    both options { disabled: true }, the note under the picker, no package sent
```

Before, the same registry gave two options with the one value `showcase_auditor`, and the save sent the name alone.

## Live check (showcase on `os dev`, console rebuilt, code at `37f5ece9`)

Evidence: `/mnt/project-files/issue-32770/live/` (`evidence.json`, 9 screenshots), rig `/mnt/project-files/issue-32770/rig.js`. Form: Setup → User Permission Sets → New (`/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user_permission_set/new`), user picked through the real lookup, every save through the REAL insert door.

**CONTROL** (nothing mocked). The real registry serves one holder of every name. The picker lists 15 options by `{label} ({name})` with no package and no note (`01-control-options.png`), and the save sends the name alone:

```
201 POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set {"user_id":"…","permission_set":"showcase_manager"}
```

**Two holders.** Two packages cannot serve one name on `main` yet (#31698 PR-2), so the registry list was mocked to serve a second `showcase_auditor` under `com.example.other`. The insert door is real:

```
409 POST … {"user_id":"…","permission_set":"showcase_auditor","permission_set_package":"com.example.other"}
      → RESOURCE_CONFLICT, details.candidates [{kind:package, packageId:com.example.showcase}]   (shown as the form's error)
201 POST … {"user_id":"…","permission_set":"showcase_auditor","permission_set_package":"com.example.showcase"}
      → the row stores permission_set_package: com.example.showcase
```

The edit form of that grant reads the stored holder ("· package com.example.showcase" on the trigger), lists both package options disabled with the note, and sent nothing.

Screenshots: `04-two-holders-create-options.png` (one option per holder), `06-two-holders-other-refused.png` (the real 409 on the form), `07-two-holders-real-saved.png`, `08-edit-package-options-disabled.png`, `09-edit-note.png`. The rig deleted the grants it wrote.

## Tests

New pins:

- `RegistryRefField.packageHolders-32770.test.tsx` (12): CONTROL listing, writing and showing; one option per holder, named; a package's pick writes the name and the package; the environment's pick and a one-holder pick clear an earlier package; the trigger shows the named holder; edit and action targets disable package options and say why, and a click on one writes nothing; read-only shows the named holder, the environment for a package that no longer serves the name, and "none named" for two packages with none named.
- `listMetadataItems-7611.test.ts` (+2): `packageId` carried verbatim, sentinel included; an item without a string package answers the same bytes as before.
- `form-create-only-autofill-32770.test.tsx` (5): the writer reaches `permission-ref` on a create form only; `lookup` / `master_detail` keep it on both; `position-ref` and `tags` get none; the writer's column reads back through `dependentValues`.
- `objectFormPermissionSetHolder-32770.test.tsx` (12): `formWritePayload` keeps the package on a grant create and strips `granted_by`; CONTROL sends the name alone; a cleared package is not sent; an edit strips it; another object with the same column names keeps its strip; no baseline, or a value the form opened with, is not a pick; field-level security, an inline form and a definition without the column keep it off; a `system` / computed / formula column is still refused. End to end through `ObjectForm` with the real widget: a package's pick saves the pair, the environment's and a one-holder pick save the name alone, a package then environment pick clears it, and an edit shows the stored holder and never sends the package.

On head `5fe46e3b`. The package suites ran on `b12e015b` and type-check on `37f5ece9`; the commits after them are a test's module-top import (its pin re-run green) and a merge of `main` that touches none of these packages. The gates and the ui `scripts/` suite ran on `5fe46e3b` itself.

- 1229 test files and 21474 tests pass across `fields`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-form`, `types`, `i18n` and the components form renderer.
- `type-check` passes for the six touched packages (58 turbo tasks); `check:type-check-debt` OK.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 25 changed ui files: 0 errors from this diff. The four it reports are `console.*` lines that already carry an inline disable on `main`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 40 commands, and all 40 exit 0 on this head (the ui `vitest run scripts/` one: 171 files, 5062 tests). `--ran` reconciles 40 of 40, with 0 NOT-MEASURED. One gate went red on the first head and was fixed: `check:test-source-alias` asked the components pin to load `@object-ui/react-runtime` at module top.

Ablation used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, inside the verify lock, with 16 legs: the adapter's `packageId`, holder grouping, disabling without a writer, writing the package, clearing it, the read-only holder, no pick by order, the field read by its form key, no writer on an edit form, the writer on a create form, `formWritePayload` keeping the package, the grant object only, a pick against the opening values only, only the `readonly` branch lifted, the name required beside it, and an edit still stripping it. Each leg ran its pin red, then restored with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD` (`/mnt/project-files/issue-32770/ablations.txt`; two legs first missed their lock turn and were re-run). One live finding was fixed before the PR: an object schema's field definition does not carry its own name, so the picker now reads its field by its form record key first (leg 8 pins it).

## Acceptance notes

- **Why no server judgement is relaxed.** The client only adds a value to an insert that the server already takes from a non-system writer and judges itself. The stamp hook keeps a named package that holds the name and refuses one that does not with `409` (measured above, real door). An update's package value is still stripped and re-stamped by the server's rule, and the client still never sends it on an edit. The form-side keep is one key on one object on a create, and it lifts only the `readonly` branch of the client's own strip: the server-owned roster, the `system` flag, the computed branches and the caller's field-level security all still apply, so nothing a caller may not write gets through. No permission check, refusal or default moves on the server or the client.
- **Targets that take a bare name list package holders disabled.** Editing a grant, `create_user` and both group-mapping actions can only send a name. A package's option there is shown, cannot be picked, and the note says why; the environment's own set stays pickable because the name alone addresses it. Nothing is resolved by order.
- **The read cell (`RegistryRefCell`) is unchanged.** A list or detail cell still draws a stored name's label by name, from the shared catalog, with no package. Where two holders label one name differently, the cell can draw the other holder's label. It is display-only and needs the row's package from each list call site, so it is left for a follow-up.
- **`position-ref` is unchanged.** Positions are not addressed by `(package, name)` in this card; a name two position items share still lists as before.
- **A field named `permission_set` with `widget: 'permission-ref'` on another object** would get the writer on its create form and offer package picks whose package the form then strips. No platform or example object declares one; every other declaration is an action param named `permissionSet`.
- **The trigger truncates a long holder label** ("… · package com.…"); the full label is in the open list.
